mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_reminder_settings (event_id, enabled, hours_before, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{enabled}, #{hoursBefore}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, hours_before = EXCLUDED.hours_before, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT o.id FROM orders o JOIN reservations r ON r.id = o.reservation_id JOIN events e ON e.id = r.event_id LEFT JOIN event_reminder_settings s ON s.event_id = e.id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND e.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND e.start_time > #{now} AND COALESCE(s.enabled, TRUE) AND e.start_time - make_interval(hours => COALESCE(s.hours_before, #{defaultHoursBefore})) <= #{now} AND o.updated_at <= e.start_time - make_interval(hours => COALESCE(s.hours_before, #{defaultHoursBefore})) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_reminders reminder WHERE reminder.order_id = o.id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets t WHERE t.order_id = o.id AND t.status = 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY e.start_time ASC, o.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_reminders (order_id, sent_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{sentAt}) ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reminders reminder JOIN orders o ON o.id = reminder.order_id JOIN reservations r ON r.id = o.reservation_id WHERE r.event_id = #{eventId}
